The '''Dahgee Jedi''' was a sect of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that thrived on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dahgee]] during the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] special [[Jedi apparel/Legends|tunics]] bearing stripes as a sign of their unswerving loyalty to the Republic. Thanks to the particular [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on Dahgee, they also built [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], the blades of which had unique properties, resembling zigzagging rods with a dark [[Silver/Legends|silver]]/black core and a [[Color/Legends|colored]] aura. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Dahgee Jedi were considered extinct because of Jedi Order not willing to send new Jedi to Daghee, but some of their [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and sabers could still be found.
